title: iEEG networks preprocessing study (Shi, Pattnaik et al. 2024; HUP + MUSC): functional-connectivity networks for 2 re-referencing x 24 connectivity pipelines (derivative)
description: A derivative dataset of intracranial EEG functional-connectivity networks computed for 148 epilepsy patients from the Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania and the Medical University of South Carolina. Networks cover two re-referencing schemes (common average and bipolar) crossed with 24 connectivity measures, computed on 2-minute interictal epochs. The dataset contains no time series and supports evaluating how re-referencing and connectivity choice affect the utility of iEEG networks.
methods_description: Networks were computed with the authors' CNT_Preprocessing_Toolkit from 2-minute interictal iEEG epochs (up to 5 per patient). Two re-referencing schemes (CAR, bipolar) were crossed with 24 connectivity measures: Pearson, squared Pearson, cross-correlation, and coherence, phase-locking value and relative entropy in delta, theta, alpha, beta, gamma, ripple and broadband bands. Results are stored as MAT files with JSON sidecars.
